newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine plans 1.2 mln T 97 alumina output - minister.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine plans 1.2 mln T 97 alumina output - minister.

text.p: Ukraine plans to produce 1.2 million tonnes of alumina in 1997, Industry Minister Valery Mazur said on Monday.
"This represents three percent more than in the previous year," Mazur told a news conference. He did not give a figure for how much alumina Ukraine expected to produce in 1996.
Mazur said Ukraine produced 1.06 million tonnes of alumina between January and November this year, a decline of four percent from the same period last year.
He said Ukraine expected total 1997 metallurgy sector exports worth $4.1 billion, comprising $1.3 billion to the Baltic and former Soviet republics and $2.8 million to other countries.
